nodes.label: Fluenta → Yalla English Hub Rebrand
nodes.rationale: Native Flutter app formerly branded Fluenta; renamed to Yalla English Hub to track the web app's Stage 2 rebrand and stay in parity with it.

nodes.label: AI Features Held (Coach/Writing/Speaking/Live Interview → 501)
nodes.rationale: AI features are held for parity with the web app; /api/ai/* intentionally returns 501 until LLM integration lands, so the UI shows a coming-soon state instead of crashing.

nodes.label: Loopback Proxy Blocks Gradle/Kotlin Daemons
nodes.rationale: A local loopback proxy on this dev machine blocks fresh Gradle/Kotlin daemons and can corrupt the Kotlin incremental cache; android/gradle.properties disables the daemon and incremental compilation to work around it. These flags should be removed on a machine without the proxy.

nodes.label: Real Listening Audio
nodes.rationale: Admin uploads clips in the web Content Studio (POST /api/media, served at /media/**); listening sections carry audioUrl and the mobile runner streams via just_audio, falling back to a simulated ticker when a section has no clip.

nodes.label: Mobile Polish (cards, empty/error states, accessibility, dark mode)
nodes.norm_label: mobile polish (cards, empty/error states, accessibility, dark mode)

nodes.label: AI Held Items (Coach/Writing/Speaking/Live Interview)
nodes.rationale: Blocked product-wide on backend/product decisions, same as web: each needs LLM integration before it can be unheld.

nodes.label: Gradle/Kotlin Daemon Loopback Proxy Issue
nodes.rationale: On this dev machine a local loopback proxy blocks fresh Gradle/Kotlin daemons; gradle.properties disables daemons + Kotlin incremental caches so the APK still builds. Remove those flags on a normal machine.

nodes.label: graphify Standing Rule
nodes.rationale: Build the graphify baseline in Task 1 and refresh it in Task 10, per the standing rule to update graphify whenever code changes.

nodes.label: TDD Task-by-Task Workflow (subagent-driven-development)
nodes.rationale: Each task follows write-failing-test → verify fail → minimal implementation → verify pass → commit, so every task ends green (flutter analyze clean, flutter test passing) before moving on.

nodes.label: Brand Rebrand Decision (Yalla English Hub)
nodes.rationale: The Flutter app was built 2026-09-03 mirroring the old Fluenta prototype; the web app went through a Stage 2 transformation to Yalla English Hub the mobile app knew nothing about, so this spec closes that gap by evolving the app in place rather than rebuilding.

nodes.label: Environments, Prerequisites & Risks (§9)
nodes.rationale: Two runtime environments: (A) this dev machine, where the Java backend can't bind because a local proxy intercepts the NIO loopback selector, so a Node stub API serves the student endpoint subset instead; (B) the owner's laptop running the real Spring Boot backend for the phone-over-WiFi demo, which is the source of truth.
